semantic_fragments.content: Multiple clauses of IEC60601-1 section 7.9.2 are evaluated for compliance. Requirements cover labeling and instructions for use including: electromagnetic interference warnings, battery management, power source specifications, equipment description and functions, operator/patient positioning, installation guidance, operational instructions, controls/displays/signals explanation, error/fault messages, operation termination, cleaning/disinfection/sterilization, and maintenance procedures. References are consistently made to the Operation Guide sections: 'NOTICE', 'SETUP AND OPERATING PROCEDURES', 'MAINTENANCE', and 'Product errors and troubleshooting'.
